name: Saperly API
description: Capability interface surface for Saperly. Slug-in-path workspace routes for the dashboard, an org-from-token (sk_) data plane for agents (numbers, connections, messaging, voice, voices, languages, usage, consent, pricing), scoped key provisioning (a keys:admin key mints ceiling-bounded child keys), and the assistant — all over the same capability layer. The MCP server is a separate JSON-RPC 2.0 surface at /mcp (not part of this OpenAPI contract).
